title: The Abiding Life
description: Practical steps for staying connected to Christ and growing in spiritual maturity.

cards.heading: The Source of Life
cards.scriptureText: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.
cards.body: Growth isn't about trying harder; it’s about staying connected. Just as a branch gets its life from the vine, our spiritual vitality depends on our daily connection to Jesus.
cards.question: What does 'remaining' or 'abiding' in Jesus look like in the middle of a busy Tuesday?

cards.heading: Fueling the Heart with the Word
cards.scriptureText: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation.
cards.body: Scripture is the primary way we get to know God's character and voice. A healthy disciple develops a hunger for the Word that moves beyond duty into genuine desire.
cards.question: What is one truth from the Bible that has recently helped you 'grow up' in your faith?

cards.heading: The Power of Fellowship
cards.scriptureText: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds, not giving up meeting together.
cards.body: You were never meant to follow Jesus alone. We need other believers to encourage us, challenge us, and help us see the blind spots in our own lives.
cards.question: Who are the people in your life who 'spur you on' toward love and good deeds?

cards.heading: Obedience as Worship
cards.scriptureText: If you love me, keep my commands.
cards.body: Obedience is not a way to earn God's love, but a response to it. As we walk in step with His commands, we experience the freedom and joy He intended for us.
cards.question: Is there an area of your life where God is currently asking for your 'Yes'?
